VMTP.SkillStamp.Title: Skill Stamp
VMTP.SkillStamp.Hint: Define custom skills and stamp them onto actors as proper sheet skills
VMTP.SkillStamp.Name: Skill name
VMTP.SkillStamp.ListHint: Committing an existing key updates that skill. A deleted skill is removed from actors on the next stamp.
VMTP.SkillStamp.DeleteAsk: Remove "{key}" from the list? Actors lose it on the next stamp.
VMTP.SkillStamp.NeedKey: Short key is required (lowercase letters and numbers).
VMTP.SkillStamp.CoreKey: "{key}" is a core skill key, pick another.
VMTP.SkillStamp.NoCore: Core skill list unavailable. Is the pf1 system active?
VMTP.SkillStamp.ScopeAll: Every character and NPC in the world
VMTP.SkillStamp.StampHint: Adds missing skills, updates changed definitions (ranks and notes preserved), and removes managed skills no longer listed. Core skills are never touched.
